name: Bulk Domain & Google Maps List -> Verified Corporate Emails & Decision-Makers (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Bulk Domain Contact & Decision-Maker Enrichment

Feed websites from **Google Maps Scraper**, **CSV**, **Google Sheets**, or a **Webhook**.

**Why this saves outbound margin:**
- **$0.00 actor start fee**
- **$0.00 charge on empty, unreachable, or suppressed domains**
- **GDPR Art. 14 provenance**: every email & executive includes the exact `sourceUrl` where it was published (`inferPatternEmails: false` so guessed emails are never billed).

Actor: https://apify.com/aegisaudit/domain-decision-maker-finder

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ domains: $json.domains, maxPagesPerDomain: 6, verifyDns: true, extractDecisionMakers: true, inferPatternEmails: false, includeEmptyDomainsInDataset: false, concurrency: 20, requestTimeoutMs: 7000 }) }}
